name: Job Hunt
description: Full job-search suite: search Zimbabwe, South Africa, Africa, Europe and global boards plus LinkedIn; read and filter adverts; tailor or create ATS-ready CVs and cover letters (PDF + Word); spellcheck and review before sending; prepare and email applications with the Gmail connector; and autofill online application forms.
help: Uses the shared workspace folder shared/jobhunt/ for your profile, job tracker, CVs, cover letters and application packs. No API key needed. Online application autofill uses the Bot's own browser tab, so log in to the site first if it needs an account. Email sending goes through your existing Gmail connector.
